premise.claim: Sync imagePullSecrets changes on existing AlluxioRuntimes to the master/worker StatefulSets and fuse DaemonSet. Alluxio has supported runtime and per-component imagePullSecrets since #4242, but its SyncRuntime is a no-op, so changing them after creation does nothing until the runtime is recreated.
premise.evidence: On merge-base 07bdbcd86 the AlluxioEngine.SyncRuntime body is a bare `return` (no-op), so post-creation spec.imagePullSecrets changes never reach the master/worker StatefulSets or fuse DaemonSet. See results/p0-base-syncruntime.txt

liveNote: L3 skipped per round policy (no KUBECONFIG layer). On a real cluster the observable signal: for an AlluxioRuntime with no imagePullSecrets configured (and IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS unset), the runtime controller issues a no-op master/worker STS + fuse DS update on every reconcile (default requeue 90s) and never reaches CheckRuntimeHealthy/CheckAndUpdateRuntimeStatus/UpdateCacheOfDataset/ShouldSyncDatasetMounts, so dataset status and mount sync go stale.
